purpose: Concept for discussion only; app implementation remains unchanged.

user_constraints.style: Match the existing three exhibition scenes with restrained typography, outlines, and lightweight controls.
user_constraints.initial_vessel: Matte unglazed porcelain bisque; this starting-stage choice is proposed rather than approved.

prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE refined 16:9 desktop concept screenshot for an EMBEDDED interactive pottery glazing module, visually continuous with the three existing exhibition scenes. This is a restrained revision, not a new theme.
Reference image 1 (window-full.png): source of the composition, quiet sunlit workshop atmosphere, elegant Chinese serif typography, low-contrast thin outlines, unobtrusive compact controls and generous empty space. Reference image 2 (museum-full.png): supporting reference for restrained exhibition typography and consistent lightweight controls only.
IMPORTANT override of reference images: remove ALL branding, ALL logos, the Chinese brand name, ALL top mastheads, the header horizontal rule, global navigation, and the works-shelf header link. Leave the top 15% as uninterrupted scene, no top bar of any kind. This module is embedded inside another platform.

Scene: a believable quiet pottery worktable beside a wooden window, soft afternoon light, understated leaf shadows on a warm plaster wall, neutral linen on a wood table. A single rounded small porcelain jar at center-left, taking roughly 45% of the image height, the same form as reference. Scientifically accurate initial state: a bisque-fired porcelain blank before glazing, matte warm ivory/off-white, fine powdery pores and very subtle throwing rings, NO glass-like varnish, NO reflective glaze, NO fired colored patches, NO decorative crazing. Fine realistic craft material detail, no exaggerated gravel or lumpy clay. Soft natural background depth of field. Modest contrast, quiet and tactile, not an extravagant stage set. The jar is the focal point.

Layout: the rightmost quarter contains a QUIET, narrow floating text/control column directly over the wall, like the existing exhibition page. No large enclosing panel/card. Serif heading around the same visual size as the reference exhibition heading, small sans-serif tool labels, warm charcoal typography and thin warm-gray outlines. Generous spacing.
Text, render exact readable simplified Chinese:
small kicker: "02 / 施釉"
heading: "为素坯施釉"
small poetic subline: "颜色藏在窑火之后"
status: "素烧瓷坯 · 尚未施釉"
tool tabs with a single thin active underline: "釉色" and "笔触"
small palette caption: "烧后釉色参考"
three small simple flat color swatches labeled "天青" "月白" "铜红". The swatches are labeled references of fired color, not thick physical ceramic tiles.
two short hairline sliders with tiny flat handles and clear labels: "笔刷大小" and "施釉厚度".
primary action: "进入烧制 →", one slim full-column-width rectangular outlined button, subtle 6px corner radius, no heavy fill, no glow.
secondary text action: "返回选坯".
Bottom-left is a compact inline process strip: "01 选坯" "02 施釉" "03 烧制" "04 出窑". The active second step uses one tiny underline; avoid large tab cards.
Bottom-right is a compact thin-border translucent control strip: "旋转" "缩放" "复位".

Single consistent UI material language: very light neutral translucent overlays on the tiny controls only, crisp fine strokes, no more than subtle blur, low opacity; no large frosted slabs, no milky glass capsules, no raised sculpted buttons, no fake stone buttons, no leather, no beveled clay UI, no strong shadows. This is the existing lightweight exhibition UI extended to the making page. Background scene materials are naturally physical, but ALL UI controls share the SAME flat restrained appearance.
No green-tinted UI, no neon, no sci-fi dashboard, no oversized callout panels, no brand, no watermark, no browser chrome, no top navigation, no slogan other than the specified subline. Single full-screen finished concept image, not a collage or design sheet.
